reports.title: Money growth and prices in Bangladesh
reports.summary: Peer benchmarks and 5 model specifications on 12 variables (1992–2025) for money, credit, interest rates, prices and growth. Bangladesh is below the peer median and worsening on 4 of 4 indicators judged.

reports.title: Inflation, the Taka and the stance of policy in Bangladesh, 1992–2025
reports.summary: Inflation rose to 10.5% in 2024 while lending rates stayed below it in each of the four years from 2022 to 2025. Nine econometric estimates, using 13 official macro variables, find a positive but imprecisely estimated pass-through from Taka depreciation to inflation.
